In this role, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise-level web applications using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM / AEM as a Cloud Service). You will collaborate closely with product owners, UI/UX designers, and front-end developers to deliver high-performing, scalable, and secure digital experiences.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Your key responsibilities:</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p>Technical Design &amp; Development: Design and develop custom AEM components, templates, dialogs, schedulers, workflows, and OSGi services using Java, HTL/Sightly, and Sling Models.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Architecture &amp; Implementation: Build robust multi-site, multi-lingual, and multi-channel publishing solutions leveraging AEM WCM, DAM configurations, and modern deployment pipelines.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Integrations: Integrate AEM with third-party systems and enterprise services, including CRM, analytics (Adobe Analytics/Target), and headless content APIs.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Code Quality &amp; Mentorship: Conduct rigorous code reviews, enforce best practices in software development (TDD, CI/CD), and
